chapter: New York dance bands and Dorsey
title: Hard leaders and the regimentation of big bands
summary: Freeman says leaders like Dorsey and Goodman had to be hard, and that sitting in tuxedos in a section felt like jail, offset by his solo space.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: But Tommy, as I said earlier, Helen, in order

for people like Benny Goodman, Tommy, highly talented people, to run the bands and take over custodianship of all of these people they had to be hard men. What do I mean when I say a hard man? If I were to have a band and God knows, I never tried, except I will tell you some very funny cases where I did try to have a band -- if I were have a band, I couldn't play if I thought that one guy in the band disliked me.
And how would he come to dislike me, by my being a hard egomaniacal leader as one had to be. Do it my way or else. God knows the things that Tommy --

So, I would say that with all of that, Tommy and Benny were pretty nice guys. Of course, when most people hear this, they are not going to agree with me that Benny was a nice guy, but I knew Benny as a kid, as I said earlier on the tapes and we don't have to go over that again, but what you want where I am going and what the next band is.

Well, I would say the best time I ever had, the most freedom I ever felt in a band, essentially a band of regimentation, I mean, you had to play in the section, you had to wear a tuxedo, you had to do -- be there. You were, in a sense, almost in jail, and the music -- if I had not been a player of improvised jazz, I couldn't make take it. I loathed the idea of having to do what somebody wants

me to do. Music should be a freer thing than that. But, again, in all realistic remembrance, it wasn't a bad deal for me, because I had a chance to play. But I often wonder about the guys who had to just sit back there at the back and play and take Tommy's insults and all that. It must have been pretty rough.
